text:
Maya: quick flag  I'm preparing a small docs PR to add a "shard-aware embeddings" guidance section in the model catalog. goal: short checklist, one-line migration note for SDK v3, and a tiny bench snippet customers can copy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4821
Owen: sounds good. include explicit per-model tags: "recommended", "supported-with-caveats", "not-tested". very helpful for support triage.
Priya: runtime asked we add a compatibility blurb for models with quantized kernels: "Quantized variants may show increased cold-start when requests hit many shards." can you add a succinct sentence and link to the runtime note?
Maya: yep adding: "Compatibility: quant-variants — prefer lower shard counts for small-batch latency-sensitive traffic; see runtime/compat-kv.md"
Owen: for the SDK migration note, call out exact param changes. Example: v2 used `shards: 4`, v3 uses `shardConfig: { count: 4, targetVectors: 256 }`. Small snippet pls.
Maya: dropping the python snippet in the PR description:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
vecs = rc.embeddings.create(model='nebula3b', input=['a','b'], shardConfig={'count':2,'targetVectors':256})
print(len(vecs[0]['vector']))
```
Priya: nit: use `shard_config` snake_case in python snippet, our SDK accepts both but docs should reflect canonical param names.
Maya: updated to `shard_config`. good catch.
Owen: can you add a tiny bench row in the model card limits table? something like: "512-d vectors, batch=8: 1-shard p50=26ms, 4-shard p50=32ms; throughput 1-shard=95 req/s, 4-shard=320 req/s (Dedicated g5.2x)" add footnote with bench script link.
Maya: added bench numbers and a footnote with a gist link to the bench CSV. Also added anchor id `#shard-aware-embeddings` for cross-doc linking.
docs-bot: CI started for PR #4821: lint, snippet-runner queued.
Priya: check wording in migration note: "If migrating from SDK v2, replace `shards` with `shard_config.count` and verify `targetVectors` semantics; older clients may ignore `targetVectors`."
Maya: reworded to match. left a short compatibility callout: "If your workload is latency-sensitive and uses quantized models, prefer starting at 1 shard and validate with production traffic."
Owen: LGTM. minor suggestion: change "ignore" -> "may not support".
Maya: updated. thanks.
docs-bot: snippet-tests passed (python, ts) for PR #4821. linkcheck found one unrelated broken anchor in /docs/legacy/embed-quickstart; leaving note in PR comments.
Maya: merging once CI completes. will follow up with a brief changelog entry and a redirect from the legacy quickstart -> new guidance. closing thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
